observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with visible wear, grime, and some blue paint marks. A black cylindrical component with '3M' written on it is attached to the side.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same transmission, focusing on the solenoid and wiring harness. A white label with text is visible on the solenoid, but the text is too small to read clearly.
Photo 2 shows the front of the transmission, with a star-shaped vent cover and various bolts and mounting points. The surface is dirty and shows signs of use.
All photos have a watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the transmission body or components in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts and gearbox'.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No visible brand or model markings in any photo to confirm Japanese origin. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The transmission may be damaged internally or have hidden wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being tested or a close-up of the internal gears and fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or severely worn

risks.risk: The transmission may not be from a Japanese vehicle, contradicting the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission's VIN tag or casting number, or a label with brand/model information.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-Japanese, which reduces value

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing critical components or have missing parts.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video showing all sides and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or missing parts

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the transmission's VIN tag or casting number.
Video or photo showing the internal condition of the transmission.
Photo of the entire transmission from all angles, including the back and sides.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
